Thesis break moves from $120 to $115, ~8.0x pro forma 2027 EBITDA. The sell-side median target of $210 (src 19) is near my bull case and was not used. agents.method_text: Engine base horizon value: 9.5x horizon NTM pre-SBC adjusted EBITDA $8.41B (0.21 x FY27 $8.1B + 0.79 x FY28 $8.5B) less $22.96B net debt incl. preferred, plus $0.63B Cogentrix tax NPV, over 334.6M shares = $172.11 (80%); DCF at 9.5% WACC / 2.0% g = $125.75 (20%). Blend $162.84.

methods.inputs: NTM adj. EBITDA at 2027-10-14 $8.41B x 9.5x = EV $79.9B; - net debt incl. preferred $22.96B - minorities $0.01B + Cogentrix tax NPV $0.63B = equity $57.6B / 334.6M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Low end of the $7.4-7.8B midpoint opportunity ($7.4B; CFO: 'trending towards the lower end') + ~$0.7B Cogentrix and Meta PPAs ('add roughly $700 million ... absent any other impacts') = $8.1B. Round-1 $0.2B ERCOT haircut removed: it had no sourced curve figure behind it. $8.1B / $21,272M = 38.1% less 10.9% D&A = 27.2%.

No management 2028 figure. $8.1B + full-year Cogentrix (~$4.0B net price / 7.25x = ~$0.55B/yr, so ~+$0.1B for the part of 2027 before close) + Meta uprate PPAs and Comanche Peak AWS load from end-2027 (+~$0.3B) - ERCOT: 2028 only ~72% hedged with forwards 'meaningfully lower' and 2028/29 PJM capacity at $325 vs $333 (2027/28) (-~$0.0-0.1B) = ~$8.5B (+5%). Replaces round-1 $9.0B, which leaned on a 1-2 analyst FMP consensus.

inputs_detail.derivation: 19,160 - 2,160 (H2-2026 Adj. FCFbG: half of guidance midpoint $4,325M) - 3,840 (2027 FCFbG ~$4,860M = 8.1B x 60% conversion (2026 guide 4,325/7,200), x 0.79 yr to Oct-14) + 3,800 (Cogentrix $2.3B cash + $1.5B assumed debt, fully counted) + 1,800 (other growth: $4.5-5B 2026-27 program less $2.3B Cogentrix cash = $2.2-2.7B, ~75% spent after 2026-06-30 by the horizon, incl. Helix calls) + 1,725 (buybacks ~$1.1B + common dividends $308M/yr (F74) x 1.29 = $0.40B + preferred dividends ~7% x $2.48B x 1.29 = $0.22B) = 20,485 + preferred 2,476 = 22,961. The Sept-2026 $1.5B junior notes are neutral to total claims (cash held or preferred refinanced).
335.6M + 5.0M Cogentrix consideration shares - ~6.9M repurchased (~$1.1B of the $1.2B authorization by Oct-2027 at ~$160) + ~0.9M SBC issuance ($113M/yr / ~$155 x 1.2 yr) = 334.6M.

NTM at 2027-10-14 = 0.21 x FY27 $8.1B + 0.79 x FY28 $8.5B = $8.41B. IPP median (CEG 11.8x, TLN 10.6x, NRG 8.9x) 10.6x and 11-peer median 10.6x, on consensus adjusted (pre-SBC) EBITDA (Talen adds back stock comp). VST today ~9.9x (EV $72.7B = 152.2 x 335.6M + 19,160 + 2,476 + 12, over ~$7.37B NTM = 0.21 x 7.25 + 0.79 x 7.4, ex-deals). 9.5x = 1.1x under the IPP median and ~0.4x under today: the horizon NTM is mostly 2028, only ~72% hedged into lower ERCOT forwards, and the PJM 2030/31+ design will be closer to decision.

Release: net price ~$4.0B after '~$0.7 billion of net present value of expected tax benefits'; not captured by the EV/EBITDA multiple or the flat 21% tax rate. x 0.9 probability the deal closes (not closed as of 2026-10-14; release expected mid-to-late 2026).

Load growth (ERCOT reserve margin falling, PJM shortfall) offset by new supply and the open PJM 2030/31+ design (PJM answer, ER26-1556).

agents.reasoning: Cause of today's drop (verified): BLS released September CPI at 08:30 ET 2026-10-14 (+0.6% m/m, +3.7% y/y; core +0.3% m/m, +2.6% y/y); Reuters reported an AI-infrastructure rout; the IPPs fell together (VST -6.7%, CEG -5.6%, TLN -6.2%, NRG -5.9%) while SPY fell ~1.2% and XLU ~0.4%; EDGAR shows no Vistra 8-K since 2026-10-05. So the move is sector-wide (AI-power factor) triggered by a market-wide macro print, not company news, and does not change fair value. PJM thesis-break flag: open, not tripped; I read PJM's ER26-1556 answer myself: a 'limited extension' through 2029/30, with the 2030/31+ path to be set after an end-2026 stakeholder evaluation; no filing to extend or lower the cap. Round-2 changes after the supervisor's review: Cogentrix's $3.8B now fully in the horizon bridge (net debt incl. preferred $22.96B, built from FCFbG guidance and the call's capital-allocation plan); FY2028 EBITDA cut from $9.0B (thin FMP consensus) to $8.5B; FY2027 raised to the sourced $8.1B (unsourced $0.2B haircut dropped); multiple 10.0x -> 9.5x (below VST's ~9.9x today, 1.1x under the IPP median); P/E leg dropped; shares from the 335.6M cover count; SBC counted once as dilution; Cogentrix ~$0.7B tax NPV added (x0.9). Fair value $162.84 (EV/EBITDA $172.11 80%, DCF $125.75 20%). Scenarios: bear $98.74 (28%), base $162.84 (50%), bull $213.23 (22%), within-scenario sigma 17%; mixture median $157.7. Ladder = 80% that mixture + 20% a lognormal at the 50% realized vol around the same median, to keep fat tails. P(>= $152) = 0.542. I keep the PJM-cap probability at 0.35 (supervisor 0.4): PJM itself framed the collar as limited and has not proposed anything for 2030/31; the risk is state pressure, which is real but undecided. Industry evidence: PJM short of capacity (2028/29 BRA at the cap, 6,831 MW short; Max Gen alerts and >$1,000/MWh prices this week), FERC's 2026-10-09 rejection of IRAS/BYONC keeps capacity tight, hyperscalers keep contracting existing nuclear (Google-CEG), while ERCOT is soft (~$30/MWh; VST and NRG both flagged lower Texas prices; ~20.9 GW batteries).
